ArtifactMetadata.description: The artifact's name, as its path names it.

name.description: must be a lowercase DNS label (a-z, 0-9, -), letter first, letter or digit last, at most 63 characters, as a stage name
name.title: Name

ArtifactMetadata.title: ArtifactMetadata

ArtifactSpec.description: The image, the source and its inputs, the builders, the first candidate's version, whether the major version has left 0, and what the artifact adds to stages.

items.description: must be a lowercase DNS label (a-z, 0-9, -), letter first, letter or digit last, at most 63 characters, as a stage name

image.description: must be a fully qualified repository name: a registry host (with a dot, a port, or localhost), then lowercase path components; no tag, no digest, at most 255 characters
image.title: Image

initialVersion.description: must be an rc version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-rc (SemVer 2.0.0 core, no leading zeros), at most 128 characters
initialVersion.title: Initialversion

propertyNames.description: must be a lowercase DNS label (a-z, 0-9, -), letter first, letter or digit last, at most 63 characters

ArtifactSpec.title: ArtifactSpec

Source.description: The code repository the artifact is built from, its tag prefix, and the input globs whose change makes a candidate, matched as git's glob pathspec magic.

items.description: must be a path glob of letters, digits and '._@+=,~%#-', with *, ?, [...] and /, at most 512 characters: no leading or trailing /, no empty, . or .. component, ** only as a whole component and never twice in a row, and every class within one component, never empty, of letters, digits, '.', '_' and ranges (a-z, A-Z, 0-9) in order

repository.description: must be github.com/<owner>/<name> in lower case: an owner of letters and digits with single hyphens inside (at most 39), and a name of letters, digits, '.', '_' and - (at most 100), not . or .., not ending in .git
repository.title: Repository

tagPrefix.description: must be empty, or the artifact's name followed by /
tagPrefix.title: Tagprefix

Source.title: Source

StageAddition.description: What the artifact adds to one stage of the policy: approvers, verifications, or both.

propertyNames.description: must be team/<slug> (lower-case letters, digits, - and _, letter or digit first, at most 100) or user/<login> (lower-case letters and digits with single hyphens inside, at most 39); lower case only, since the host compares these names without case

items.description: must be a lowercase DNS label (a-z, 0-9, -), letter first, letter or digit last, at most 63 characters, as a stage name

description: The declaration of one artifact, artifacts/<name>/artifact.yaml, owned by its team (ADR-026 section 5); metadata.name is the name in the path. Beyond what this schema checks, GORA refuses a declaration in which: tagPrefix is neither empty nor the name followed by /; an input or a builder is named twice; a stage addition names neither approvers nor verify, or names a verification twice; a user/ approver's number is not 1. An optional field is absent or holds a value, never null, and a mapping or list it holds is never empty. Top-level fields appear in the order apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec, writtenBy.
title: GORA artifact declaration, gora.tools/v1alpha1
